robot_description2: Extra! Extra! Read all about it! When the world of high-speed racing collides with the world of high-stakes robotics, someone has to cover it — and nobody does it better than Plum! Energetic, unrelenting, and dressed to impress in her bright red jumpsuit, Plum is the official news reporter and commentator for the Battle & Chase circuit. Armed with her trusty mic and a trusty news team, she captures every crash, turbo boost, and dramatic last-second victory for the masses! She’s equipped with real-time data analytics and jet skates that allow her to zip across the track to get the best angle — no matter the risk. She's not afraid to call out racers on their "less-than-clean" tactics either, especially if they’re being sponsored by you-know-who (Looking at you, Wily!) Despite the dangers, Plum thrives in chaos, and there's nothing she loves more than breaking a story before it breaks her. She's even rumored to have broadcasted a full lap of Battle & Chase while dodging live missiles—and still managed to keep her lipstick flawless. Whether it’s lights, camera, or a literal explosion behind her, Plum’s on the scene with sass, speed, and sizzling one-liners. And remember: if Plum’s in your pit crew, you better race like you mean it, or she’ll be roasting you on the nightly highlight reel!
